thread:
maya: quick sync — we need a consistent policy for routing by tier+region and model fallback. hitting weird behaviour when enterprise bursts exceed reserved capacity.
kevin: do we enforce quota at the router or downstream? my vote: router-level hard throttle for free/pro, enterprise gets queued + overflow to reserved. return structured 429 with "retry_after" and fallback hints.
maria: UI question — how should console surface fallback rules? simple toggle or full priority list per tier+region? cc @kevin.
alex: preference: priority list + weight. customers will want to snapshot the effective config. example config (draft):
```
{
  "tiers": {
    "free": { "max_rps": 5, "fallbacks": ["small-variant"], "region_overrides": {} },
    "pro": { "max_rps": 50, "fallbacks": ["small-variant","quantized-variant"], "region_overrides": {"eu": {"max_rps": 40}} },
    "enterprise": { "guarantee": "reserved_pool", "overflow_policy": "queue_then_fallback" }
  },
  "global": { "default_fallback": "small-variant" }
}
```
kevin: +1 but the router needs a compact runtime representation. maybe compress to ruleset entries: `(tier, region) -> [variants with weights]` so lookup is O(1).
maya: telemetry: we need signals to show how often fallback occurred and token delta vs primary. console should have timeline + per-tenant counts. Sabrina can you add those metrics? @sabrina
sabrina: yes — will add metrics: fallback_count, fallback_tokens_saved, primary_latency_p95_when_fallback. also emit tag: "fallback_reason" (capacity|quota|health).
ops-bot: note: deploy of router-v2 scheduled for Tue 09:00 UTC, includes fast lookup table for routing.
maria: UX: can we add "simulate" button to console so operators can run a request against a config before rolling out? prevents surprises.
alex: on internal API debate — current endpoints: `/v1/routing/policy` vs `/internal/routing/config`. prefer `/v1/routing/policy` for stability (public-ish contract) and offer an internal draft store.
kevin: also think about enforcement modes: soft_warning (emit metric + sample), hard_block (429), degrade (route to cheaper variant). default = soft for pro, hard for free.
maya: action items: 1) kevin prototype condensed ruleset + 429 payload shape, 2) sabrina add metrics and tags, 3) alex + maria design console snapshot/simulate UX, 4) ops confirm router rollout window. will sync Thursday. :thumbsup:
